parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/domain module covers one concern, order fulfilment: the order side (Order, OrderLine, OrderState, OrderRepository) and the stock side (Product, ProductRepository, StockReservationService), plus shared support (DomainError, IdGenerator). Every file uses the shared DomainError type the same way. Each rule is written once: the order of states lives in ORDER_STATES and Order.advance calls nextState(); assertOrderStatus calls isOrderStatus; the line checks are only in OrderLine.create; the stock checks are only in Product.reserve and Product.release, which the service calls. StockReservationService reaches storage only through the ProductRepository port. No file goes around the module's own abstractions. Order.cancel lists the cancellable states by hand, but that is a separate rule, not a copy of one defined elsewhere.
